verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring workflows is a fair question for a browser-automation framework, but the evidence pack never documents a scheduler, cron triggers, or recurring job runs. The closest items are cross-run persistence (user-data directories, Browserbase contexts) and caching. These support repeated runs that a user launches themselves; they are not a built-in schedule, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
